title: Cybersecurity Threat Simulation System
description: Simulates active database compromise scenarios (insertion / deletion threats) via a Telegram Bot interface. Implements real-time DB recovery logic, rollback transaction chains, and alert propagation. Designed to stress-test incident-response pipelines and validate backup integrity under adversarial conditions.
imageAlt: Terminal output showing live threat simulation — red alert lines scrolling

title: Smart Resource Allocation Framework
description: Integrates ML-driven workload prediction with OS scheduling primitives (Round Robin, Priority Scheduling) and DAA algorithms (Greedy, DP) to dynamically distribute CPU/memory across competing processes. Reduces average wait-time by prioritizing predicted high-burst tasks before queue saturation.
imageAlt: Server rack internals showing resource allocation metrics

title: HybridShield — Endpoint Threat Detection
description: Fully offline Linux EDR combining ClamAV signature scanning, YARA rule matching, and Shannon entropy heuristics. Features real-time inotify file-watching, multi-threaded analysis pipeline, auto-quarantine with permission stripping, and a live Rich TUI dashboard for operator situational awareness.
imageAlt: Dark terminal with real-time threat analysis logs
